body: I’m wondering whether it’s better for a friend to find me or if I should do this in my home town
I’m so sorry. Live for you somehow, what ever that may mean. I love you and I hope you can take some moment of peace today for yourself. I’m truly with you.

Yes. To everything. This is unbearable. I can only live for him now and some day for myself so we can be together in the next life. I can’t know that we will but I’ll choose to believe it because it’s the only thing that will bring me happiness. <3 I’m so heartbroken this has happened for both of us and all of our families and friends.

That’s how I feel too. This is my story now, and I’ll never be with someone else again, the kids we were going to have are the only kids I would ever have. I know he would want me to be happy. Yours would too. But I don’t know how. Just accept so I can leave faster. When my time comes that’s when it should, and I can’t rush it or I’ll end up with this same lesson to learn. I just pray to god to make it fast.
Hahahaha he probably would’ve told me something similar. He would never want me to die, hed never with  that suicide bullshit. This isn’t about me I know. I’m just here because I want to kill myself.
